sources.heading: Formal Dispute Resolution: Sponsor Appeals Above the Division Level Guidance for Industry and Review Staff
sources.text: tification. B. Additional Considerations Regarding Responses to Appeals That Request Advisory Committee Review If a sponsor seeking resolution of a scientific and/or medical dispute requests advisory committee review of the matter, CDER or CBER should determine whether such review is appropriate and would be helpful to CDER or CBER at that time in the FDR process. CDER or CBER should communicate this determination to the sponsor following the procedures described in section V.A., Responses to an Appeal. 1. Granting a Request for Advisory Committee Review If a sponsor’s request for review by an advisory committee is granted, the matter should be brought to the next scheduled advisory committee meeting for which there is adequate time available on the agenda for discussion of the issue(s). Because of administrative concerns related to organizing each advisory committee meeting (e.g., establishing an agenda, sending background information to the advisory committee members before the meeting), it may not be feasible to raise the matter at the next scheduled meeting of the appropriate advisory committee.
